bugs.title: Supplier transaction history omits real bills and outgoing payments
steps: Sign in to Nexstock QA Company and select the active isolated supplier QA P2 Vendor mvo2d41l.
Create a direct QA vendor bill in Bills (AP): subtotal Rs 97, tax Rs 10, total Rs 107, future due date and a unique QA reference.
For the payment scenario, record a manual cash installment of Rs 20 and verify paid Rs 20 / due Rs 87 in AP.
Open that supplier's details and inspect all history tabs.
Open Purchase Orders history and search visually for the newly recorded bill/payment.
bugs.expected: The supplier has a complete transaction ledger with its POs, received shipments, vendor bills and outgoing payments, including amounts and document linkage.
bugs.actual: The page exposes Catalog Products and Purchase Orders only. The exact newly saved QA bill references, balances and Rs 20 payment are absent, with no Bills/Payments ledger view. Independent unpaid and partially paid fixtures reproduce the omission.
bugs.comment: Add the supplier's bill/payment ledger and integrate receipt/purchase-order linkage. Use the saved QA references and payment events when retesting. Populated PO/GRN history cannot yet be certified because P2-PO-001 prevents provisioning; no separate defect is assumed for those blocked paths.
